continue_points.note: end+1 would be 58, but 57 was grafted forward: mainline resume is 52 — chapters 52 'Measurements' and 53 'Horoscope' are never adapted anywhere, and ep 22 picks up at 54. Reading 52-53 then watching on is seamless.
